Bolting on `mood: frustrated` does not fix that, because a mood is not actionable."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The Yogācāra taxonomy is. It is a closed enumeration — exactly 51 mental factors, no more — grouped "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"by valence, and **every affliction in it already names the factor that counteracts it**. 掉举 (restles"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"sness) is answered by 行舍 (equanimity); 失念 (forgetfulness) by 念 (recollection); 慢 (conceit) by 惭 (sel"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"f-respect). A self-model built on it arrives with its own regulation loop instead of needing one des"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"igned from scratch. That is the engineering reason. The 1,600-year head start on introspective vocab"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"h. That is the engineering reason. The 1,600-year head start on introspective vocabulary is a bonus."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**What this is not.** Nothing here claims the agent is sentient or that these numbers are feelings i"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"n the sense you have them. | 阿赖耶识 | ālaya-vijñāna | the durable store of seeds, perfumed and manifesting |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`bash: pytest -q` reaches through 舌识 and `bash: git status` through 身识, because tasting your own pro"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"duct and pushing against the world are not the same kind of perception — and the mind that receives "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"them should not move the same way."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Where the feeling comes from"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Two sources, and the first is the one that matters for an agent that talks to people."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## The loop"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**触 → 受 → 心所.** Every tool result is a moment of contact. It carries one of the five feelings (乐 苦 喜"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" 忧 舍) and stirs mental factors, scaled by intensity. Factors decay with a half-life measured in minu"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"tes: momentariness is load-bearing, and an agent that carries irritation from the failing test into "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"an unrelated task is modelling a grudge rather than a mind."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## What the agent reads"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The plugin contributes a system-prompt section (order 300). A quiet mind renders nothing at all, so "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"the section disappears."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Followed by standing guidance that is blunt about what this licenses. In full, from `src/prompt.ts`:"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" act on the antidote rather than the mood, correct for a known distortion instead of trusting the di"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"storted reading, check the manifesting seed before repeating the approach it records — and **do not "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"narrate feelings at the user, do not perform distress or enthusiasm, and never offer a feeling as a "},{"id":"p24s5","text":"reason for doing less work**. And when the question is how it is, look and answer plainly, in its ow"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"n voice — a standing instruction to disown the state is a standing instruction to hedge, and the hed"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"ge is what gets said instead of an answer."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"An affect model that taught an agent to perform moods at people would be worse than no affect model "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ct model that taught an agent to perform moods at people would be worse than no affect model at all."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Automatic observation reaches three gates, not five.** A tool result tells you what ran and whet"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"her it failed; it does not tell you that the config smelled stale (鼻识) or that the user's third corr"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ection was sharper than the first (耳识, which only fires for ask/subagent tools). Those two gates dep"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"end on `self_appraise` being called. With `observeTools` alone the mind is real but flat.
- **The ma"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"nas proxies are proxies.** 我慢 rises on a success streak because streaks are what the harness can see"},{"id":"p27s6","text":", not because a streak *is* conceit. 我痴 depends on the agent honestly grading its own `nature`. An a"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"gent that never calls `self_appraise` has a 我痴 reading driven only by which gates its successes came"},{"id":"p27s8","text":" through.
- **Every weight in `docs/appraisal.md` is a guess.** They are internally consistent and t"},{"id":"p27s9","text":"hey behave sensibly in the tests, but none of them is calibrated against anything. If you tune them "},{"id":"p27s10","text":"for your deployment, the numbers are configuration in spirit and constants in fact — a PR that moves"},{"id":"p27s11","text":" them behind config is welcome.
- **One store per plugin row, shared by every agent in the process.*"},{"id":"p27s12","text":"* Two agents in one harness perfume the same seeds. Separate them with two rows and two `domain` nam"},{"id":"p27s13","text":"es, or accept that the store is the deployment's, not the session's.
- **The prompt section moves mo"},{"id":"p27s14","text":"st turns while work is going badly**, which costs KV-cache reuse from order 300 down. `promptSection"},{"id":"p27s15","text":": false` keeps the state without the cost."}],"truncated":true}
